chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام said: “The sanctuary of the grave of al-Husayn عليه السلام extends five farsakhs from the four sides of the grave.”

key_terms.الصّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.حَرِيمُ: the protected sacred precinct or sanctuary
key_terms.خَمْسَةُ فَراسِخَ: five farsakhs, a measure of distance
key_terms.قَبْرِ: grave; the burial place being described

ai.seo_question: How far does the sanctuary of Imam al-Husayn’s grave extend?
ai.summary: This hadith states the extent of the sacred sanctuary surrounding the grave of Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام. It indicates the distinguished sanctity and special status of his burial place in Shia tradition.
